simple.summary: אֵבֶר (ʼêber) means a pinion First listed occurrence: Ezek 17 3.

definitions.full: H83. eber אֵ֫בֶר noun [masculine] pinions (from strength, in poetry & figurative, plural in sense) as of dove Psa 55:7 ; eagle Isa 40:31 ; הָא ׳אֶרֶךְ of king of Babylon under figure of eagle Ezek 17:3 (|| הַכְּנָפַיִם גְּדוֺל of broad, overshadowing wings).
